core_obligations: Affine setup: X covered by finitely many affines U_i = Spec(C_i); Z \cap X_t empty means I_i generates the unit ideal after localizing at q; clear denominators to get x_i + sum f_ij c_ij = g_i with g_i not in q; shrink T to make the equations x_i + sum f_ij c_ij = 1.
Approximation: B = colim B_lambda over finitely presented A-algebras; lift x_i, f_ij, c_ij and the equation to some B_lambda; set T' = Spec(B_lambda), t' the contracted prime.

Conclusion: Z' the scheme-theoretic image of Z in X_{T'}, computed as the kernel on the affine pieces; x_{i,lambda} lies in the defining ideal, so the displayed equation forces Z' \cap X_{t'} = empty.
proof_roadmap: Clear denominators on the fibre condition.
Lift the equations to a finite level.
difficulty_reason: Ideal equations x_i + sum f_ij c_ij = 1 lifted from B to a finitely presented B_lambda with the prime tracked along the colimit, then the scheme-theoretic image computed affine-locally. The interplay of clearing denominators, the directed colimit of algebras and the scheme-theoretic image is genuinely multi-step.
